parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The business space key. If not passed, the default business space is accessed. The key value can be obtained from the business management page of the primary account.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID, used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, this field does not need to be passed when calling the Chat API for the first time. The chatbot will initiate a session and return the SessionId of the session in the Chat API response. For subsequent conversation rounds of the visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat API, and the chatbot will continue the conversation based on the SessionId.
